title: 6T4 Challenges
description: Adds a growing collection of unique challenges into Minecraft.
body: This is a Minecraft Fabric mod which adds a growing collection of unique challenges into Minecraft. A "6T4" button is added to the title screen and pause menu where challenges can be toggled and configured. ![6T4 Menu Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91a906bd5d1ca9e4d3add7891cd5a359254a748d.png) Almost all the challenges were made for a video or a live stream I have done on my [YouTube channel](https://youtube.com/@flutterz6t4). So if you want to watch and learn more about them, there's a good chance a video exists regarding that specific challenge. I made this mod with content creation in mind. I wanted something I could keep adding to rather than making a new mod for every idea, and a way to give back to the community. So this is especially made for fellow creators. It's very easy to toggle a challenge on and off and add your own twists with modifiers, configurable options, and/or challenge combinations. Just make sure to follow the license instructions and show some love back by crediting me when using this mod in a video or stream (: --- ## Features - Adds a "6T4" button to the title screen and pause menu - Toggle and configure challenges individually, no restarts needed - Stack multiple challenges at once for unique combinations - Most challenges have configurable options - Modifiers to globally tweak the game on top of any challenges - Seasonal challenges - In-game HUD overlay showing active challenges (toggle via keybind) - Each challenge shows its multiplayer compatibility status ![Modifers screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ca93526c4efe3527baf7a77f31164bb136b7f67.png) --- **Getting started:** Install the mod, click the "6T4" button on the title screen or pause menu. Toggle any challenges on or off and jump in. On a server, changes sync to all players automatically as long as you have OP. ![Pointing at 6T4 Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc3421244f3b816dc5f76912e4dffdb77429dced.png) ![Pointing at 6T4 button in pause screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2a3b3bb5d73d0e2c25992c63b8014ecf216ca1e_0.webp) > **Multiplayer:** Compatibility is added to most challenges where possible. But seeing as I personally do 99% of these challenges alone, it's likely that multiplayer won't always work as expected. > **Versions:** This mod will be actively maintained only for the latest supported Minecraft version. ## Available Challenges Almost every challenge has configurable options - feature toggles, intensities, distances, difficulty tweaks, and more. Open the options for any challenge from the 6T4 menu. The goal is to eventually have 64+ challenges in total. Hence the name :b | Challenge | Description | | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Can't Touch Green | You die if you touch any green blocks, items, or mobs. | | Can't Touch Red | You die if you touch any red blocks, items, or mobs. | | Can't Touch Blue | You die if you touch any blue blocks, items, or mobs. | | Disappearing Blocks | Blocks disappear when you walk off them. | | Exploding Mobs | All mobs will explode when they die. | | Can't Breathe Air | You drown in air but can breathe in liquids, suffocating blocks, and with water breathing potions. Respiration enchantment helps you breathe in air longer. | | Super Knockback | When you take damage, you receive enhanced knockback that sends you flying. | | Ender Pearl on Damage | When you take damage, an ender pearl shoots out randomly with configurable speed and arc. Ender pearl damage is disabled to prevent infinite teleportation. | | Faster Mobs | All mobs move faster than normal. | | Flame On | You are always on fire and can never be extinguished (Water toggle in options). | | No Experience | Gaining any experience kills you instantly. This includes XP from mob kills, blocks, and other sources of experience. | | Invisible Mobs | All mobs are invisible. | | Mob Spawn on Eat | Eating anything spawns a random mob near you. | | Random Drops | Every block and mob drop is randomized every single time, no loot table swapping. | | Can't Use 'A' | You die if you pick up any item or block with a display name containing the letter 'A'. | | Bedrock Trail | Blocks turn into bedrock when you walk off them. | | Lava Trail | Lava appears where you walk. | | Mob Disappearing Blocks | Blocks disappear when any mob steps off them. | | Teleportation Only | Can only use the provided Infinite Ender pearl or Infinite Chorus fruit to move around. Movement keys are disabled. | | Trident Rain | Tridents rain down from the sky. | | TNT Rain | TNT rains down from the sky. | | Anvil Rain | Anvils rain down from the sky. | | Arrow Rain | Arrows rain down from the sky. | | Potion Rain | Potions rain down from the sky. | | Gift | Only available in December. While active, you receive random gifts on a timer - items, mobs, or other entities. | | Dimensional Rift | MUST ACTIVATE EXPERIMENTAL MODE - tells the client it is in the Nether while the server keeps you in the Overworld, force-loads scaled Nether chunks, and routes Nether mob tracking. Expect bugs, glitches, and possible crashes. | *...and many more challenges on the way!* --- ## Modifiers Modifiers are global tweaks that apply on top of any challenges. Mix and match them freely. | Modifier | Description | | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Player Scale | Changes the size of all players. | | Heart Count | Sets how many hearts all players have. | | Movement Speed | Base speed for all players. | | Peaceful Completion | Allows beating the game whilst in Peaceful difficulty. | | No Natural Regen | Disables natural health regeneration from hunger. | | Real Time Timer | Shows a real-time timer on screen. Counts up continuously, even when paused or in menus. | | In-game Timer | Shows an in-game timer on screen. Only counts up while you are actually playing. | | Start in Nether | On a new world, you spawn in the Nether instead of the Overworld. | *...more modifiers on the way too!* --- ## Permissions This mod is All Rights Reserved. ✅ Allowed: - Use in public or private modpacks with proper credit - Showcase in videos, livestreams, or other content - Share links to the official download page ❌ Not Allowed: - Redistributing the mod files on other sites without permission - Modifying, decompiling, or reusing the code/assets - Claiming ownership of the mod If you're unsure about something, feel free to contact me. --- ## Bug Reports/Support Found a bug or need help with the mod? Join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/C3b9T7H) and head to the **#bugs-support🔨** channel. --- ## Contact For further questions or updates, join the Discord and contact me [@Angel6T4](https://discord.gg/C3b9T7H) I make mods mostly for use in YouTube videos. So if you want to further support me, check out my [YouTube Channel](https://youtube.com/@flutterz6t4?si=xjsZvHKzFVOJkUS_)
